faq.question: Is Birdcast suitable for CEO or senior leadership content?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast’s studio setup works well for CEO interviews, founder stories, leadership messages and executive communication.

faq.question: Can the recording feel premium and serious?
faq.answer: Yes. The session can be planned with professional lighting, camera positioning, audio and a controlled interview flow.

faq.question: Can executive interviews be used on LinkedIn?
faq.answer: Yes. Executive interviews can be prepared for LinkedIn, websites, internal communication, PR assets or campaign pages.

faq.question: Should questions be prepared in advance?
faq.answer: Yes. Prepared questions or talking points help keep the session efficient and make the final recording more focused.

faq.question: Why should we message before booking?
faq.answer: Executive projects often involve audience, approval and timing requirements, so a short WhatsApp discussion helps confirm the right setup.
